transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We're evaluating business internet providers. FiberLink gave us a quote for 1GB at $800/month.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I appreciate you considering us in your evaluation. FiberLink is a solid provider. Before I respond to their quote, can you tell me about your uptime requirements and what happens if you experience service interruptions?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Uptime is critical - we process financial transactions 24/7. Even short outages cost us thousands.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's exactly why I'd recommend our Enterprise plan over FiberLink. While they offer 99.5% uptime, our 99.99% SLA means 4x less downtime - about 4 minutes monthly vs their 22 minutes. For financial processing, that reliability difference is significant.
